changelog.message: op updated for high-performance Swift-backed active application and window monitoring
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Monitors the frontmost active application and window title on macOS and outputs the application info in real-time.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable global application and window title monitoring.

ports.name: Interval (ms)
ports.text: Interval in milliseconds at which the native Swift monitor queries application state.

ports.name: Application Name
ports.text: Name of the currently frontmost active application.

ports.name: Bundle Identifier
ports.text: Bundle ID of the active application (e.g. com.apple.Safari).

ports.name: Process ID
ports.text: Process ID (PID) of the active application.

ports.name: Window Title
ports.text: Title of the active window within the frontmost application.

ports.name: On Changed
ports.text: Fires a trigger when the active application or its window title changes.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the sidecar daemon.
